title: Viva Engage: network analytics gets custom date ranges, faster refresh and people-manager filters
summary: Hold: Microsoft already documents Viva Engage Premium as the licence required for custom date ranges, so the statement that licensing for these enhancements is unpublished is too broad. The roadmap facts and the existing organisational-filter control are supported.

- Date Range

- Department
- Job Title

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters
claims.claim: The arrival default for these enhancements is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage network analytics people manager filters custom date ranges enable default switch privacy manager attribute. Read roadmap, Learn analytics and filtering, and Support analytics; the existing filters default is stated, but no enhancement rollout default is given.

claims.claim: The tenant filter toggle is at Viva Engage admin center > Setup & Configuration > Analytics and AI > Network Analytics > Organizational Data Filters.
claims.quote:
On the Setup & Configuration tab, select Analytics and AI.
3. Go to the Network Analytics section to access the Organizational Data Filters toggle. When you enable it, users can filter their analytics by employee attributes.

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell operation for the Organizational Data Filters toggle is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage Organizational Data Filters toggle Microsoft Graph beta PowerShell API analytics settings. Opened filtering, analytics and Graph engagement-api-overview?view=graph-rest-1.0; no toggle operation found.

claims.claim: No separate UI or automation switch for people-manager filters, custom date ranges or faster refresh is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage network analytics people manager filters custom date ranges enable default switch privacy manager attribute; Organizational Data Filters toggle Microsoft Graph beta PowerShell API analytics settings. Read filtering, analytics, Graph overview and Support analytics; no switch found.

claims.quote: Verified Admins, Network Admins, and Corporate Communicators can use analytics filtering in the Network Analytics dashboard.

Read filtering, analytics and Support analytics; the toggle is documented for employee-attribute filtering, without explaining control of these additions.

claims.claim: The existing Organizational Data Filters feature is enabled by default.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The per-user entitlement described is Viva Engage Premium, required to use all analytics features.
claims.quote: To use all analytics features, users must have Viva Engage Premium

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Viva Engage Premium is bundled with Viva Suite and Employee Communications and Communities licences.
claims.quote: Viva Engage Premium, which is bundled with the Viva Suite and Employee Communications and Communities (C&C) licenses.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Visibility of Network analytics requires at least 50% of network users to hold Viva Suite, Employee Communications and Communities or Viva Engage premium licences.
claims.quote: For a visible Network analytics dashboard, at least 50% of the network’s users must be licensed for Viva Suite or Employee Communications and Communities, or for the Viva Engage premium license.

claims.claim: The filtering page says the dashboard is unavailable below 50% licensing for Viva Suite or Employee Communications and Communities.
claims.quote: If less than 50% of your network’s users are licensed for Viva Suite or Employee Communications and Communities, the Network Analytics dashboard is unavailable.
claims.fix: Replace this bullet with: 'Learn requires at least 50% of network users to hold Viva Suite, Employee Communications and Communities or Viva Engage premium licences for dashboard visibility; the filtering page lists only the first two.' The broader list is at https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/engage/analytics.

claims.claim: Organizational Data Filters is a Viva Engage premium feature.
claims.quote: Organizational Data Filters is a Viva Engage premium feature

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a licence requirement specific to the enhancements, including custom date ranges.
claims.quote: A Custom date range feature allows you to specify any date range, beginning with any calendar day and extending by any number of days. This feature is available only with Viva Engage Premium.
claims.fix: Replace the licence-absence statement in licensing.notes and Cost and licensing with: 'Microsoft Support documents custom date ranges as available only with Viva Engage Premium; licensing specific to the new people-manager filters and faster refresh is not yet published.' Cite https://support.microsoft.com/topic/0d9f6fd5-6b0c-45a2-a0aa-0576ae1f6895.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate price or meter for these enhancements is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage network analytics enhancements custom date ranges people manager licensing pricing meter. Read Learn analytics and filtering, service-description search excerpts, and Support analytics; found Premium entitlement but no enhancement-specific price or meter.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Existing organisational filter attribute values with fewer than 10 users are grouped under Other for privacy.
claims.quote: Any attributes with fewer than 10 users are also grouped into the Other category to maintain user privacy.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described manager-filter-specific privacy protections or confirmed the same minimum group size for them.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage network analytics people manager filters manager attribute privacy permissions new roles default rollout. Read Learn filtering and analytics, Support analytics and returned excerpts; no people-manager privacy or threshold statement found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: Viva Engage takes organisational attributes from Entra ID by default.
claims.quote: By default, Viva Engage pulls organizational attributes for each user from a network’s Entra ID directory.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admins can alternatively upload a CSV containing organisational data through the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Alternatively, Microsoft 365 admins can also upload a CSV file that contains organizational data from the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

claims.claim: A CSV for Organizational Data Filters must include the Microsoft_PersonEmail column.
claims.quote: For Organizational Data Filters, the CSV file must include the Microsoft_PersonEmail attribute as a column header.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Viva Engage performs no cleaning of uploaded organisational data, so its accuracy needs review.
claims.quote: Viva Engage doesn't perform data cleaning or data processing, so be sure to review your data before you upload.

claims.claim: The profile attribute and CSV columns used by the new people-manager filters are not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage network analytics people manager filters manager attribute privacy permissions new roles default rollout. Read filtering and analytics, Support analytics and returned excerpts; no attribute mapping for the new manager filters found.

claims.claim: No new role is described for the enhancements.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage network analytics people manager filters manager attribute privacy permissions new roles default rollout. Read roadmap, filtering and analytics; searches returned existing roles but no enhancement-specific new role.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes reporting views and filters, not actions taken on users' behalf.
claims.quote: These enhancements make it easier to explore trends, understand audience engagement, and measure communications impact across the network.

claims.claim: The roadmap names no new data source or autonomous action.
claims.quote: custom date ranges, faster activity data refreshes, updated dashboard and metric table designs, expanded organizational filters with search, and new people-manager filters for viewing direct reports or full reporting hierarchies

claims.claim: Organisational filter values are corrected in their source directory or CSV rather than edited in Viva Engage.
claims.quote: By default, Viva Engage populates Organizational Data Filters using user profiles within Entra ID. For these filters, we recommend that you review the country, department, and job title fields.

claims.claim: Network analytics is restricted to network admins and corporate communicators rather than general users.
claims.quote: Only Engage network admins and corporate communicators have access to the Network Analytics dashboard.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/engage/employee-retention-metric to sources for the exclusive-access statement in the impact rationale.

claims.claim: Existing organisational filtering displays Other and Unspecified categories.
claims.quote: The Other and Unspecified categories appear at the bottom of the dropdown to provide context of their data quality and distribution, but we don't calculate metrics for those categories.

claims.claim: Country, department and job title are the existing source fields Microsoft recommends reviewing.
claims.quote: For these filters, we recommend that you review the country, department, and job title fields.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist requests checks of licence coverage and source organisational data that have no corresponding controls-table rows.
claims.quote: Check the Viva Engage Premium licence share; Review the country, department and job title fields in Entra ID, or the CSV you upload. The table contains only Organizational Data Filters and a separate-switch documentation gap.
claims.fix: Remove the two Before rollout checklist bullets beginning 'Check the Viva Engage Premium licence share' and 'Review the country, department and job title fields'. Their factual background is already retained in Cost and licensing, Scope and Risk assessment; do not add control rows.

controlChecks.governs: Whether users can filter network analytics by employee attributes
